blocks.text: Veteran actress Erlinda Villalobos, known for her roles in several films, including “Ekstra” and “Manang Biring,” died on Sunday, Oct. 11. She was 84. Her family confirmed Villalobos’ passing in a statement posted on her Facebook page on Sunday. The cause of her death was not immediately disclosed. “With a heavy heart, we announce the passing of our beloved grandmother Erlinda Villalobos,” the statement reads. “It’s never easy to say goodbye to someone who has been such a special part of our lives.
